subject: Post-demo: Dedicated capacity sizing & deployment pathway (OptiRetail)
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>

Subject: Post-demo: Dedicated capacity sizing & deployment pathway (OptiRetail)

Hi Sanjay — thanks again for the demo time today. Quick recap and the asks we agreed on so we can move to a sizing recommendation: 

Call highlights (from our side):
- Primary workload: low-latency product recommendations (real-time personalization) called from storefront API.
- Typical request pattern: mix of short context prompts + recent session history (median token ~450, 95th ~1.2k; occasional up to ~2k).
- Desired latency SLO: P95 generation <= 180ms for single-request flows; background batch reranks can be higher.
- Traffic profile: target sustained ~75 RPS (peak bursts up to ~240 RPS), expected diurnal pattern with heavy morning/evening peaks.
- Compliance: OptiRetail prefers VPC/private networking for production; initial POC can run on Dedicated with VPC peering.

Questions / Inputs we need from you to finalize sizing:
1) Can you share a small sample of 100–200 real requests (prompt + session length) so we can get an accurate token distribution? (CSV attached template).
2) Do you have a hard requirement for on-prem vs VPC? You said compliance leans private VPC; confirm if Dedicated + VPC peering is acceptable for contractual phase 1.
3) Any constraints on GPU families (A100 vs H100) or preference for quantized / INT8 paths for cost optimization?
4) Procurement timeline & PO/contract owner (copy Lara if helpful).

Next steps we propose:
- You upload a representative sample to the sizing template (attached: optiretail-prompt-sample.csv + redwood-dedicated-sizing-template.xlsx).
- Schedule a 60-min sizing workshop with our infra lead to run a quick load profile and agree on HW mix (link below).
- We’ll deliver a 2-option sizing: (a) baseline Dedicated for your SLOs and (b) cost-optimized option that trades GPU flavor/quantization.

Attachments: optiretail-prompt-sample.csv (sample schema), redwood-dedicated-sizing-template.xlsx

Thanks — I’ll coordinate availability for the workshop once you confirm sample upload and procurement contact.

– Naomi Feldman

Subject: Re: Post-demo: Dedicated capacity sizing & deployment pathway (OptiRetail)

Thanks Naomi — great recap. Confirming a few items from our side and answering the questions: 

- Token distribution: average ~450 tokens / request, 95th ~1.2k, max ~2k for long session lookbacks. We can provide a 200-row sample by EOD (will use your CSV).
- Traffic: sustained 65–80 RPS expected initially, with capacity to handle 240 RPS short bursts (30–60s).
- Latency: P95 target <= 200ms is firm.
- Deployment preference: Compliance team wants private VPC for production. For the POC, Dedicated with VPC peering is acceptable so long as audit logs and access controls are maintained.
- GPU preference: No strict vendor lock. We’re interested in H100 for lower latency but need pricing delta vs A100. Also interested in any quantized FP16/INT8 options if Redwood supports them with minimal quality degradation.

Procurement contact: Lara Owens (cc’d). We’ll aim to share the sample and a SOC2 summary. Attaching the SOC2 high-level (small PDF). Our procurement timeline: initial PO target within 4–6 weeks after sizing and contract review.

On the call you mentioned a quick throughput test — we can allocate a small test window next week if you provide the test harness instructions.

— Sanjay

sanjay@optiretail.com | +1 206-555-0147

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

Subject: RE: Post-demo: Dedicated capacity sizing & deployment pathway (OptiRetail)

Sanjay / Naomi — quick sizing notes based on your numbers (Naomi — we discussed these on the call):

Summary assumptions:
- Sustained RPS: 75; Peak burst: 240 (30–60s).
- Median tokens/request: 450; 95th: 1.2k; max 2k.
- Latency P95 <= 200ms target.

Recommended starting configuration (two options):
1) Baseline (predictable latency): 2 x A100-80GB (dedicated nodes) with continuous batching + prefix caching. Expected to meet sustained 75 RPS and handle typical peaks with autoscale to 3 nodes. This keeps quantization conservative (FP16) for quality.
2) Performance / cost-optimized: 1 x H100 + 1 x A100 (or 2 x H100 if budget allows) and enable mixed INT8 quantized path for ~25–40% cost reduction at some quality risk on long-tail prompts. Use token-level caching for session history to reduce repeated compute.

Concurrency & throughput notes:
- For median tokens (~450), per-token generation tflops indicate ~12–18 concurrent requests per A100 depending on model selection and decoding strategy. With batching tuned to 32–64 tokens, that yields ~70–100 RPS per A100 for short responses.
- For 95th/2k token requests, throughput drops — we recommend a small dedicated pool for large-context requests to avoid head-of-line blocking (e.g., route >1k tokens to a large-context node).

SRE / ops asks for the load test:
- Please confirm test window and provide representative sample payloads (we’ll run a gradual RPS ramp to 250 RPS).
- We’ll send a sizing workbook after we ingest your sample (link: https://drive.redwood.ai/sizing/OPTI-4721-questionnaire).

Next steps (from Redwood):
- Naomi: schedule the sizing workshop (we can do tomorrow or early next week).
- OptiRetail: upload sample CSV + confirm test window.
- After test: Redwood will produce a short two-option report (baseline vs optimized) with estimated monthly $/token and headroom numbers.

I’ll be online Thursday morning PST for a brief sync if that helps.

— Karthik
